title: Set Your Decision Height: Land or Go-Around Safely!
description: Learn how to set your decision height and make safe landing or go-around decisions in this informative video. Setting your decision height is a critical aspect of aviation, and it's essential to understand the factors that influence this decision. In this video, we'll explore the importance of decision height and provide you with valuable tips and best practices to help you land or go-around safely. Whether you're a student pilot or an experienced aviator, this video is designed to help you improve your decision-making skills and reduce the risk of accidents. By the end of this video, you'll have a better understanding of how to set your decision height and make informed decisions in the cockpit. Watch now and take your aviation skills to the next level!
